title: I Used the Museum Member-Preview Line on the Staff Guest Who Cut

parts.text: I queued at 8:58 a.m. for the member preview I paid for in November. A staff guest in a lanyard walked to the front and said they were checking sightlines. Sightlines with a date. I was forty, member, holding a timed ticket. The rope sign said members and press only. I photographed the sign, the lanyard, and the date on her phone. Then I asked the floor supervisor whether sightlines needed a plus-one latte. At 9:03 the guest tried to scan a staff QR that the preview list rejected in a sad beep.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The staff QR just failed on the preview list in front of the rope.

social.video_title: Sightlines with a date cut the member rope — Part 1/2
social.description: November dues, timed ticket, a latte plus-one. The beep was sad. Would you have held the rope?

parts.text: They opened a staff walk-through at 10, which is a real sightline. The guest waited. I entered at 9:05 with members who had paid. The supervisor thanked me like I had done security. I had done a sign. The exhibit was better without a date explaining it. Lanyards are not timed tickets. November still mattered at 8:58. I looked at paintings in order.

social.description: Members first, sad beep, paintings in order. Was a date a press pass?
